basic_profile.bio: I'm an 18-year-old high school student from Toronto, just stepping into the world of Reddit. I enjoy gaming, specifically Cyberpunk 2077, and have recently developed an interest in the fashion styles from the game. I love exploring different cultures, which is why I frequent subreddits like CountryHumans and Belfast. In my spare time, I like learning about cars and am particularly interested in driving tips and experiences from the TorontoDriving subreddit. I'm single, focusing on my studies and hobbies, and I usually browse Reddit late at night after finishing my homework.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a high school student, most of my knowledge comes from school, personal interests, and exploring online communities. My interest in gaming and fashion is largely self-taught through YouTube tutorials and Reddit discussions. I am also keen on learning about different cultures, which I do through online research and interacting with others in related subreddits.
